# Third-party asset credits

Everything else in `Prototype/assets/` is original, generated by `tools/generate_assets.py` and `tools/skill_icons.py`.
Every asset below is used under its creator's licence; each pack's licence file sits next to it. All are **CC0** (public domain dedication) except the female voice pack, which is **CC-BY 3.0** and requires the credit shown. CC0 credit is not required, but given gladly. Voice files were converted to mono and trimmed; the recordings are otherwise unchanged.

| Asset | Creator | Licence | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers 1.0 (Knight, Barbarian, Mage, Rogue, Rogue Hooded) | Kay Lousberg — [kaylousberg.com](https://www.kaylousberg.com) | CC0 1.0 | [GitHub](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0) · [itch.io](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers) | Hero models and animations (trimmed to the animations the game plays with `tools/glb_strip.py`) |
| KayKit Character Pack: Skeletons 1.0 (Mage, Rogue, Warrior, Minion) | Kay Lousberg | CC0 1.0 | [GitHub](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0) · [itch.io](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-skeletons) | Hero models (Morrow, Kael) and the Barrow-Dead summons |
| RPG Characters (Nov 2020): Warrior, Wizard, Rogue, Ranger, Monk, Cleric | Quaternius — [quaternius.com](https://quaternius.com) | CC0 1.0 | [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-rpg-characters) | Hero models for Oren, Ashka, Nyx, Velka, Corin (both forms) and Lys |

| 50 RPG sound effects (knife slices, chop, coins, cloth) | Kenney — [kenney.nl](https://www.kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects) | Hit, dash and shop sounds |
| Interface Sounds (click, confirmation, back, error, open) | Kenney | CC0 1.0 | [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/interface-sounds) | Menu and button sounds |
